limitations: Candidate topology; no factory polarity claim.
Shared reversible core with lumped section parasitics; no hysteresis or measured distributed field.
External wiring and monitor validation are not provided by this model.

assumptions: Ideal 12/22/41/-16 V converter rails; actual 5 V regulator retained.
Periodic repetition of a captured static field initializes the circuit; no cold thermal timeline.
Unmeasured yoke geometry and tube capacitance/leakage. The selected yoke profile declares whether R/L and field are jointly derived or independent.
Finite 1 Gohm DC leakage at isolated C19 midpoint and horizontal yoke; not a source component.
L4 uses a passive three-winding same-terminal-polarity hypothesis; coupling defaults to zero. Factory coupling/polarity remain unresolved.
Exploratory solver tolerances require independent refinement; completion is not acceptance.

limitations: Finite packing regions represented magnetically by ideal thin cosine sheets; linear ferrite; no saturation, hysteresis or frequency-dependent core loss.
Separable axial field/end-return approximation; not a solved 3D fringe field.
Wire resistance uses declared copper resistivity and idealized saddle return length.
Geometry and electrical target constraints are unmeasured hypotheses, not fitted to an image.

initialization: DC operating point with optional voltage guesses; not a periodic-state checkpoint

assumptions: The post-gun neck/funnel is an absorbing anode-connected sleeve, not a model of real glass.
Grid-2 interception is accounted before trajectory launch.
Gun-wall, reversed and incomplete trajectories have no supported collector.
